mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 205.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, which suppresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 205.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output, which supports corporate profit growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 11500.0 billion dollars indicates a slowing economy, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 11500.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs signals weak labor market conditions, which dampens consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 100000.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising CPIAUCSL and elevated FEDFUNDS signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS above 5.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05).
